description:
VERSION 3.4.1

• Animation when you react in a status, click the green heart 💚 (You can change it, MB Settings → Home screen → Status reaction animation)
• Tab order change added again
• Improvements to the Tab bar

~ Shared new status notification has been fixed
~  Bugs fixed in Android 11 and lower
~ The issue with the sound changing when sending or receiving messages has been resolved.
